rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user ID, then reviewed the user’s orders via read-only tools. It correctly identified the laptop order as pending (not delivered), appropriately pivoted from a return to a cancellation option, and explicitly requested confirmation of the exact change and reason before performing any write. After receiving confirmation, it executed the cancellation through the tool, which returned status “cancelled” and a refund to the original payment method. The agent’s final message accurately reflected the tool results. No policy violations or unsupported claims were observed.
